title: Untitled (Framed Collage with Targets)
description: Framed mixed-media collage presenting a large ivory central void surrounded by densely layered fragments of printed paper, ribbon stripes, and circular target motifs in black, red, and yellow. Chess pieces, concentric rings, and polka-dot elements cluster along the lower and upper borders within a black frame.
composition: central void framed by dense peripheral collage
